headline: The complete 18x18 E8 holonomy bracket-rank tensor compiles onto packet18 as group-add target routing plus a 13-record deficiency table. All 324 brackets are nonzero; 284 use the full target dimension by default. The remaining 40 ordered pairs are exactly 13 C2xC2 inversion orbits.
packet_boundary: Uses external holonomy-character addition, not coset multiplication in G/C4.
physical_boundary: Schedules targets and ranks only; no structure constants or microscopic bracket implementation is claimed.
